name: Bonfire
rootCause: missing caller authorization lets anyone force-sell any approved holder's tokens. Lost: ~66 BNB (~$47-50K); 58.78 BNB reproduced from a 5-victim subset (~98.7% of tokens drained)

descriptions.text: missing caller authorization lets anyone force-sell any approved holder's tokens. Lost: ~66 BNB (~$47-50K); 58.78 BNB reproduced from a 5-victim subset (~98.7% of tokens drained)

The BonfireSwap router’s transfer lacked access control: it did not require msg.sender == from or check the caller’s allowance on from. An attacker set approved holders as from and themselves as to, drained TOKEN via existing victim→router allowances, then forwarded funds through a same-token pool swap. About 41 approved holders were hit; loss ~$50,000.
